positions.title: Senior DevOps Engineer / Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Lead infrastructure and platform operations for core services within Adobe Developer Platform, including Adobe I/O Runtime, I/O Events, App Builder, Exchange, Developer Console, and Developer Website. 
- Design and operate cloud infrastructure across AWS and Azure using Terraform, including IAM/OIDC, networking, container registries, DNS, and managed services 
- Lead and contribute to migrations of multiple production services to Ethos Flex, coordinating infrastructure redesign, observability coverage, rollout planning, and risk mitigation 
- Standardize deployment patterns across environments and regions 
- Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and platform services 
- Build observability dashboards, alerts, telemetry pipelines, and operational tooling using Grafana, Prometheus, Splunk, and New Relic 
- Lead incident response and production stabilization efforts for distributed platform services

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Technical Lead
positions.description:
Focused on Kubernetes operator development and automation of Magento store lifecycle management on Adobe Cloud infrastructure.
- Designed and developed Kubernetes operators in Golang to automate provisioning and lifecycle management of customer Magento stores. 
- Designed Helm charts and CI/CD strategies for multi-environment deployments 
- Contributed to architectural decisions around operator lifecycle, deployment workflows, and platform integration 
- Worked across Kubernetes platform evolution from EKS to Ethos PaaS

positions.title: DevOps Engineer
positions.description:
Part of a small DevOps team responsible for migrating a large on- premise omnichannel commerce platform to AWS. 
- Migrated legacy infrastructure to AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, SQS, AutoScaling, Lambda) 
- Designed secure, scalable cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code 
- Implemented CI/CD pipelines to automate build and deployment processes 
- Contributed to monolith-to-microservices transition using Kubernetes and Jenkins 
- Played key role in cloud modernization efforts during Magento’s acquisition by Adobe

positions.title: DevOps Engineer
positions.description:
- Support developers in deployment tasks
- Creation and improvement of Python tools to automate deployments via REST API and web interface
- Build and manage the infrastructure supporting the service components that comprise the web services backend.

Skills:

- Experience with large scale, secure and automated AWS deployments
- Experience with automation frameworks (Ansible, SaltStack)
- Programming Languages: Bash, Python, Golang

Technologies involved: AWS (EC2, S3, SQS, EB, RDS, DynamoDB, AutoScaling, Lambda), Ansible, Redis, Elasticsearch, Consul, Zookeeper, Apache Kafka, Terrafom, Kubernetes

positions.title: System and Network Engineer
positions.description:
• System and Network Engineer working with a small team focused with on the goal of maintaining and improving one of the best hosting infrastructure in our country.
• My role is primarily setting up and creating architectures and technical designs for current and future network initiatives. Additionally, managing and monitoring systems and network infrastructure.

Skills:

- Experience administrating hundreds of Debian servers along with some FreeBSD machines.
- Configure, maintain, manage and secure services such as Apache, MySQL, Postfix, etc.
- Communicate and collaborate with development, product, and customer service departments.

Technologies involved: Xen Hypervisor, Nexenta & ZFS, EqualLogic, Cisco, D-Link, Fortinet

Scripting & development: Perl, Python, PHP, Bash, Subversion, Fabric

positions.title: Technical Support Engineer
positions.description:
•  Resolve advanced issues related to all services on Debian and FreeBSD servers, software installations and handle escalations from Level 1 Support.
• Provide e-mail and telephone support to end users.
• Document all activities and tasks related to customer queries in our incident case management system in order to keep track of the current status, the actions taken, and to keep our customers informed on a regular basis.
• Use of analytical and troubleshooting techniques to identify and solve customers' issues.
•  Collect new features proposed by customers in order to improve our product, reporting these features to our development team.

Technologies involved: Apache2, MySQL, Postfix, Dovecot, Nginx, Varnish, Memcache, APC, IPTables

Tools: Zendesk, OTRS, JIRA

positions.title: Technical Support and Helpdesk
positions.description:
• Hardware/Software problem analysis
• Simulated complex network problem scenario and identified possible solution
• Implemented and maintained user access policies which prevented users to exploit IT infrastructure
• Administrate Windows server machines (Windows Server 2003/2008) for access control and domain control, file server, DNS server, AD, etc.
• Fix escalated customer facing issues via ticket system.

honors.issuer: Issued by Universitat Oberta de Catalunya · Jun 2013
